text: Rachell Marie Hofstetter, born on January 8, 1992, is an American online streamer, YouTuber, and podcaster known by her pseudonym Valkyrae. She is a co-owner of the gaming organization 100 Thieves and the founder and CEO of Hihi Studios. Hofstetter grew up in Moses Lake, Washington, and is of Filipino and German descent; she has three brothers and one younger sister. Her mother encouraged her to pursue video games as a hobby from a young age, and she attended community college, working at GameStop to support herself, later earning an associate degree in arts and science. While working at GameStop, she began sharing her gaming content on Instagram, which led her to start live streaming on Twitch in 2015. She gained recognition by playing Fortnite in 2018 and joined 100 Thieves as their first female content creator that October. In 2020, she signed an exclusive contract with YouTube, leaving Twitch on January 13, and her stream grew rapidly, peaking at over 100,000 concurrent viewers by late 2020, largely due to her gameplay in Among Us and collaborations with streamers like Disguised Toast, Sykkuno, Pokimane, PewDiePie, and Cr1TiKaL, as well as public figures such as Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Lil Nas X, and Jimmy Fallon. She became the fastest-growing female streamer of 2020 and surpassed Pokimane as the year's most-viewed female streamer. In December 2020, she won Content Creator of the Year at the 2020 Game Awards. In April 2021, she and CouRageJD joined 100 Thieves' ownership group, receiving equity in the company valued at $190 million by Forbes. She won Gaming Creator of the Year at the 2021 Adweek Creator Visionary Awards in May 2021 and the Livestreamer award at the 11th Streamy Awards in December 2021. In 2022, she was named to Forbes' 30 Under 30 list in the games category and was nominated for Best Variety Streamer at the 2022 Streamer Awards in March. In December 2022, she was nominated for Streamer of the Year and Variety Streamer at the 12th Streamy Awards. On March 11, 2023, she co-hosted the second annual Streamer Awards, which averaged 425,000 live concurrent viewers. In August 2023, she was nominated for Streamer of the Year and Variety Streamer at the 13th Streamy Awards. In February 2024, she won The Sapphire Award at the third annual Streamer Awards. In May 2024, she streamed heavily playing a character on the modded Grand Theft Auto V server NoPixel and was named among Gold House A100 honorees. In July 2024, she participated in MrBeast's "50 YouTubers Fight for $1,000,000" video. In December 2024, she was nominated for The Sapphire Award at the fourth annual Streamer Awards. By January 2025, her exclusive YouTube contract had expired, and she returned to Twitch on January 8, celebrating her 10th streaming anniversary and 33rd birthday, becoming the most-watched female streamer on Twitch during her first week based on hours watched. On February 24, 2025, she began a week-long IRL streaming marathon titled Sis-A-Thon in Los Angeles with Brittany "Cinna" Watts, which was postponed due to the January 2025 Southern California wildfires. On March 2, during the final night, the streamers were targeted by a stalker at Pacific Park on the Santa Monica Pier; a man named "Russell" approached them, asked for Emiru's phone number, and became aggressive after being refused, threatening to kill them and requiring intervention by Cinna's cameraman Rosii. The stream ended early, and Hofstetter tweeted the following morning confirming everyone was safe, thanking supporters, and announcing the event would be rescheduled. Later that day, she and Watts went live to officially conclude the marathon. On November 7, 2025, Hofstetter and Watts began their second week-long streaming marathon, Sis-A-Thon 2. In 2021, she appeared in music videos for "DayWalker" by Machine Gun Kelly featuring Corpse Husband, "Build a Bitch," and "Inferno" by Bella Poarch. In March 2022, she voiced a Hannya Squad member in the English dub of Tribe Nine; in December 2022, she voiced Squad Commander Red in Sonic Prime. In 2023, she made a cameo as herself in The Family Plan; in January 2025, she voiced the lead character "Ratchet" in Goldbeak. In April 2025, it was revealed she had filmed a 30-second cameo for A Minecraft Movie, though the scene was cut and she only appears in the background in the final release. In 2025, she was featured in QTCinderella (Blaire)'s music video for "Forever." In September 2022, she became an ambassador for Gymshark. In September 2024, she founded Hihi Studios to develop and produce IP for graphic novels, TV, and film with a focus on anime-inspired content. In June 2025, Hihi Studios announced its first project, a webtoon called Bad Influence. In April 2021, she participated in an Among Us charity livestream with Jimmy Fallon, Gaten Matarazzo, Noah Schnapp, The Roots, and other streamers, raising over $25,000 for Feeding America. In June 2022, she participated in a Minecraft charity tournament for The Trevor Project and donated $10,000. In November 2022, she donated $15,000 to No Kid Hungry during Ludwig Ahgren's event. In December 2022, she participated in "Thankmas," raising over $10 million for World Central Kitchen. In February 2023, she donated $10,000 to earthquake victims in Turkey and Syria. From October 2024 to April 2025, she co-hosted a podcast called Press Esc with Alyssa "Alythuh" Dios, which concluded when Dios moved to Hawaii. In July 2025, she was announced as the new co-host of Wine About It with QTCinderella. On October 19, 2021, she launched her skincare brand RFLCT, targeting gamers and those with prolonged screen time, claiming products protect against blue light damage. The brand faced backlash due to insufficient scientific evidence; dermatologist Kathleen Suozzi stated that screen exposure typically does not cause skin damage in those not prone to melasma or hyperpigmentation. Hofstetter acknowledged the criticism, expressed confusion over the lack of information on the website, and promised to provide more details, though she was later informed that the research could not be released publicly. She expressed a desire to end the partnership but was contractually bound. On October 30, 2021, RFLCT ceased operations, with a statement noting that the brand had decided to move forward on new paths. Hofstetter resides in Los Angeles. From 2016 to 2021, she was in a relationship with Michael "Sonii" Sherman. From April 2023 to July 2024, she lived with Leslie "Fuslie" Fu, Miyoung "Kkatamina" Kim, and Christina "TinaKitten" Kenyon, known as "The Roomies." In 2024, she endorsed Kamala Harris in the U.S. presidential election.
